response.sql: WITH per_txn AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_shortint, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvol FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), mix_avg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_shortint) AS mix_shortint FROM per_txn GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT p.transref AS transaction_ref, p.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, p.avg_shortint AS avg_short_interest, p.avg_optvol AS avg_option_volume_ratio, p.avg_shortint / NULLIF(m.mix_shortint, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM per_txn p JOIN mix_avg m ON m.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
